contract: Compare each decoded audio frame's sample rate, channel count, order, mask, speaker for every plane and exact layout description. Speaker discriminants are the public AVChannel IDs. Unknown positions have no mask.

Compute the native plane permutation from each published order and the Vorbis I or Opus family 1 permutation for the same channel count. Fold kind 4 for geometry, positions and UTF-8 name, kind 3 for each permutation with its count, and kind 3 for effective and published stereo downmix when present.

Downmix gains use nearest 1/100000, independently of floating-point representation. Vorbis and Opus include wide authored streams with one to eight channels. The pinned AAC encoder does not produce an ADTS PCE beyond eight channels. DTS did not publish downmix information in the 7.1 probe.
This operation adds layout facts to audio decode. Decode and output mixing are measured by the codec workloads.
